parameters.query: with r as (select decode(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'hex') as a, decode(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '') || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 'hex') as b), t as (select $1::text as id, translate(rtrim(encode(a, 'base64'), '='), '+/', '-_') as mod_token, translate(rtrim(encode(b, 'base64'), '='), '+/', '-_') as remove_token from r) select id, mod_token as "modToken", remove_token as "removeToken", encode(sha256(convert_to(mod_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex') as "modHash", encode(sha256(convert_to(remove_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex') as "removeHash" from t

update ttw.generations set gallery_status = 'pending', gallery_mod_hash = $2, gallery_remove_hash = $3 where id = $1 and status = 'done' and gallery_status = 'none' returning id, email, cat_name, scene, result_path_45
